blocks.label: Practice
blocks.instructions:
Go / No-Go PracticeA vessel contact will appear on every trial.
  • Click anywhere when you see the Shchuka-B (target)
  • Do nothing when you see the Kilo-877 (non-target)
  • Vessels appear with equal frequency — stay focused on the pattern
  • You have 1 second to respond
  • Feedback will tell you if you were correct
